description:
At its heart is vocalist and composer Aditya Prakash, whose distinctive
artistic voice bridges Carnatic tradition and contemporary experimental music.
Drawing on classical training, adventurous composition and cross-genre
collaboration, Prakash approaches melody as a powerful vehicle for both
spiritual expression and human connection. His vocals move effortlessly
between the nuanced phrasing of raga, explorations of timbre, spoken word and
wordless expression. Built as fluid, evolving frameworks rather than fixed
compositions, his work invites deep listening, spontaneous interplay and the
possibility of discovery in every performance.

name: Windmills Music Night - Aditya Prakash Ensemble - HYD

performer.description: The Aditya Prakash Ensemble explores the space where raga, improvisation, chamber music and experimental song converge. Rooted in the melodic intricacies of South Indian classical music and informed by jazz, folk and avant-garde traditions, the ensemble creates a sound that is both intricately composed and instinctively alive. Each performance becomes a dialogue between tradition and innovation, structure and spontaneity, unfolding through moments of quiet introspection and compelling intensity.

description:
This piano, double bass and drums trio creates atmospheric music rooted in a
quest for simplicity, drawing inspiration from cinema, classical music and
contemporary pop-folk. Each composition evokes a rich palette of images,
colours and emotions, moving between softness, intensity and intimacy.  
  
With Vermeilles, their second album released on Label Bleu, ROUGE reaches a
new milestone, showcasing greater maturity and collective mastery. Their
melodic and colourful compositions blend traditional jazz with contemporary
soundscapes, creating music that is both sophisticated and accessible.
name: Windmills Music Night - ROUGE BLR

performer.description: Founded in 2018 by pianist Madeleine Cazenave, ROUGE quickly established itself as a leading presence in the French new jazz scene.
performer.name: ROUGE

description:
Rooted in Indian classical traditions while embracing contemporary influences,
Amritha approaches music as a space for exploration and reinvention. Her debut
single, Afterword (2020), brought together Bharathiyaar’s poetry and
contemporary composition, reflecting her distinctive musical sensibility.
Through her performances and collaborations, she continues to explore the
intersections of tradition and modern expression, creating a sound that is
both rooted and forward-looking.
name: Windmills Music Night - Amritha Thankachy Live! - BLR
